name: NOVIPNOAD Local
description: Independent NOVIPNOAD provider over the site's own player. Title discovery uses the WordPress REST search with TMDB Chinese/HK/TW aliases; the three post shapes (single movie, whole-series post with episode buttons, one post per episode) are all resolved. Playback needs no browser: the player page's WebAssembly auth step is decoded in plain JavaScript and the enc-vod payload is decrypted with a fixed keystream.
